docs.title: POMUS
docs.text: Pomus is the frontend application designed to present and visualize the data output from the Aquilo and Nexus systems.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: Pomus provides a user interface for browsing and exploring the high-quality, enriched data produced by the Nexus pipeline. It is built with a focus on being "HTML first," prioritizing speed and simplicity.

docs.title: Key Functionalities
docs.text:
• Data Visualization: Displays processed datasets from Aquilo and relationship metadata from Nexus.
  • Server-Side Rendering: Uses a minimalist, server-side approach to deliver content efficiently.
  • Modern Web Tech: Employs Pico CSS for lightweight styling and HTMX to handle API requests without complex client-side JavaScript.
